issues.original_line: Surprise! I found you from up here. That's bad for you, actually.
issues.reason: Tone drifts slightly cold/wry -- 'That's bad for you, actually' lands as a dry knowing quip rather than cheerful oblivious customer-service energy. It has a faint menacing undertone inconsistent with moronic chipperness.
issues.correction: Surprise! I found you from up here! Now I will shoot you a whole bunch. How exciting!
